description: Local-first Windows workspace, storage and resource companion (unsigned preview): read-only file inventory, personal learning, understandable resource view
notes: Loomward is an UNSIGNED preview: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run.
Its state lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Loomward Data\v3\, outside the Scoop folder, so `scoop uninstall loomward` keeps it; delete that folder to remove all state.
Needs the Microsoft WebView2 runtime (built into Windows 11 and current Windows 10). Install it with `scoop install extras/webview2` if the window stays blank.
pre_install: # Extract-only install: drop the NSIS plumbing 7-Zip unpacks next to the app.
# Fail closed on an unexpected installer layout instead of leaving a broken app.

if (!(Test-Path "$dir\loomward-desktop.exe") -or !(Test-Path "$dir\contracts\v3\examples\commands")) { throw 'Unexpected Loomward installer layout (loomward-desktop.exe or contracts/v3/examples missing).' }
